records.public_safe_text: on [date] at approximately 12:36 hrs, i officer gallegos #3031 was dispatched to a major accident call at [roadway] reference a pedestrian being struck by a vehicle. my bwc was activated during this incident. i made contact at the scene with multiple witnesses and other officers. the subject who got struck was already being treated by fire and ems personnel. i identified multiple witnesses to the accident including guzman, adrian h/m [date], frallo, debra u/f [date], and butson, dennis w/m [date]. all three of these witnesses gave a story and said they saw the suspect vehicle strike the pedestrian and flee the scene. the injured subject was later identified as lattimore, brian leroy jr. b/m [date]. [medical facility] via amr. i met with him later on to get his story. butson, frallo, and guzman said they saw the traffic at e. timberview facing eastbound get a green light. the traffic started to move and so did brian. brian [roadway]. at this intersection and was walking eastbound across the lanes of traffic. brian was reported to have been in the crosswalk and was walking towards the median. witnesses accounts said brian was approximately [roadway] from the west side of the intersection when he was struck by a silver pickup truck that was turning right to [roadway]. brian was lifted off his feet and flung towards the median. brian crawled to the median and the pickup truck [roadway]. witnesses stopped to help him and make sure he was ok. they called 911 for him. later on while i was still on scene gathering information, the suspect decided to return to the accident scene and tell his side of the story. he was identified as vargas-gallega, eduardo h/m [date] tx dl 24269245. he said he was turning right to go sb from [roadway]. he said he had the green light. he contended that brian was not in the crosswalk and he had a green light. he said he turned, accidentally hit brian (even though brian [roadway]) and continued driving because his 7 yoa daughter was in the back seat and got scared. eduardo said he dropped his daughter off at home ([roadway].) and came back to the scene. all my other witnesses said that brian was in the crosswalk and had made it across approximately 2 1/2 lanes of traffic when eduardo struck him with the driver's side bumper. eduardo fled and later came back. he led officers to his home where he allowed us to take pictures of the damage to his truck. he was driving a 2014 silver gmc sierra tx lp [identifier]. officer pena 3150 used his bwc to take pictures of eduardo's truck. eduardo was advised of the report number and [medical facility] to talk to brian. he advised he was in the crosswalk and had the ""walk"" symbol for his row (right of way). he said he started to walk and had crossed 2 lanes of traffic heading eb across s. collins. he said he didn't see the truck coming and got struck from behind. he said he flew close to the median and crawled up onto it. brian had minor injuries and looked to have some pain, bruising, scrapes, and cuts from the impact. he was treated at mca for his injuries. i advised brian and his father of the report number and left the scene. end of report. 460 ***arrest warrant issued based on offense report, vargas-gallaga arrested on [date], case to be filed with tcda. det dj szatkowski #1599***
